### YMCA turns crisis into capability at scale

YMCA partnered with Accenture to build a community-based model that helps refugees and displaced
people gain skills, find work, and rebuild their futures—moving from relief to long-term capability.

[
Read more
][135]

### How UNICEF's GenU is closing the youth skills gap

Through UNICEF’s partnership with Accenture, young people gain access to AI-powered skilling,
digital learning and entrepreneurship opportunities that connect them to employment and brighter
futures.

[
Read more
][136]

### Philipstown's wire cars go global

Philipstown’s wire car tradition is accelerating onto the global stage through immersive
storytelling, gaming and commerce—fueling opportunity and driving impact far beyond the track.

[
Read more
][137]

### Google Cloud reimagines lead enrichment with agentic AI

The leading hyperscaler replaced batch processing with an agentic model that delivers decision-ready
outputs up to 30x faster—sharpening prioritization while enabling more confident sales decisions.

[
Read more
][138]

### Bristol Myers Squibb scales AI to rewire everyday work

The life sciences leader is putting people at the center of its AI ambition—rewiring work across the
enterprise to empower employees, drive innovation and accelerate the delivery of therapies to
patients.

[
Read more
][139]

## We believe that business is the greatest platform for change

Grounded in trust, customer success, innovation, equality, and sustainability, we’re committed to

## Salesforce CRM FAQs

### What is Salesforce?

Salesforce is the [**#1 AI CRM**][86] (customer relationship management) platform. We bring
companies and customers together by providing a unified set of applications — powered by [agentic
AI][87] and data — that help every department, including sales, service, marketing, commerce, and
IT, work as one. You can learn more about [what Salesforce is][88] and [what Salesforce does][89] by
visiting [our official resources][90]. Our cloud-based agentic solutions help you find more leads,
close more deals, and provide better service to your customers, all on a single, integrated agentic
platform.

### What is CRM software and why do businesses in India need it?

[**CRM**][91] stands for **customer relationship management. **It’s a technology for managing all
your company’s relationships and interactions with customers and potential customers. A CRM system
helps you:

**• Organise **contact information, leads, and customer service data
**• Automate** tasks like logging calls and sending follow-up emails**
• Analyse** data to understand customer behaviour and business performance

A CRM, especially one powered by AI like Salesforce, is essential for growth because it gives you
a** single**, [**360-degree view** of every customer][92], allowing you to build stronger, more
profitable relationships at scale.

### What is agentic AI and how is it used in Salesforce?

[**Agentic AI**][93] refers to advanced artificial intelligence systems that can act
[**autonomously**][94] to achieve a specific goal with minimal human intervention. Unlike
traditional [AI][95] that only generates content or analyses data, agentic AI can reason, plan
multistep actions, and execute tasks.

In Salesforce, agentic AI — part of our [**Agentforce**][96] technology — is used to:

**• Automate **complex workflows like lead qualification or service case resolution
**• Predict** business outcomes, such as which deals are likely to close
**• Personalise** every customer interaction across marketing, sales, and service channels

### How does Salesforce CRM help businesses grow in India?

Salesforce offers agentic CRM solutions tailored for companies of all sizes, from[ startups and
small businesses][97] to large global enterprises. Our Agentforce 360 Platform is flexible and
scalable, allowing you to start with the essentials you need — like sales, service, commerce, or
marketing — and easily add more functionality as your business grows. This ensures you only pay for
what you use and have an[ AI and CRM][98] platform that can grow with your business.

[Salesforce Starter][99] helps you hit the ground running for free, providing an all-in-one suite of
sales, service, and marketing tools designed specifically for small business needs. The setup
process is simple so you can focus on building customer relationships immediately, with the peace of
mind that the full power of the Salesforce ecosystem is ready whenever you are.

## Salesforce CRM FAQs

### What is Salesforce?

Salesforce is the [**#1 AI CRM**][86] (customer relationship management) platform. We bring
companies and customers together by providing a unified set of applications — powered by [agentic
AI][87] and data — that help every department, including sales, service, marketing, commerce, and
IT, work as one. You can learn more about [what Salesforce is][88] and [what Salesforce does][89] by
visiting [our official resources][90]. Our cloud-based agentic solutions help you find more leads,
close more deals, and provide better service to your customers, all on a single, integrated agentic
platform.

### What is CRM software and why do businesses in India need it?

[**CRM**][91] stands for **customer relationship management. **It’s a technology for managing all
your company’s relationships and interactions with customers and potential customers. A CRM system
helps you:

**• Organise **contact information, leads, and customer service data
**• Automate** tasks like logging calls and sending follow-up emails**
• Analyse** data to understand customer behaviour and business performance

A CRM, especially one powered by AI like Salesforce, is essential for growth because it gives you
a** single**, [**360-degree view** of every customer][92], allowing you to build stronger, more
profitable relationships at scale.

### What is agentic AI and how is it used in Salesforce?

[**Agentic AI**][93] refers to advanced artificial intelligence systems that can act
[**autonomously**][94] to achieve a specific goal with minimal human intervention. Unlike
traditional [AI][95] that only generates content or analyses data, agentic AI can reason, plan
multistep actions, and execute tasks.

In Salesforce, agentic AI — part of our [**Agentforce**][96] technology — is used to:

**• Automate **complex workflows like lead qualification or service case resolution
**• Predict** business outcomes, such as which deals are likely to close
**• Personalise** every customer interaction across marketing, sales, and service channels

### How does Salesforce CRM help businesses grow in India?

Salesforce offers agentic CRM solutions tailored for companies of all sizes, from[ startups and
small businesses][97] to large global enterprises. Our Agentforce 360 Platform is flexible and
scalable, allowing you to start with the essentials you need — like sales, service, commerce, or
marketing — and easily add more functionality as your business grows. This ensures you only pay for
what you use and have an[ AI and CRM][98] platform that can grow with your business.

[Salesforce Starter][99] helps you hit the ground running for free, providing an all-in-one suite of
sales, service, and marketing tools designed specifically for small business needs. The setup
process is simple so you can focus on building customer relationships immediately, with the peace of
mind that the full power of the Salesforce ecosystem is ready whenever you are.

## Project Your Thought Leadership

Today, the #1 result on Google is earned by the page with the best content, on the website that
demonstrates the most subject matter expertise. We combine the latest technology with human judgment
and intuition, using generative AI for persona research, machine learning for marketing insights,
and highly-trained writers to craft each piece.

But we don’t stop at producing truly standout content. We connect that content to conversion pages
that ensure your #1 rankings turn into qualified leads. And equally importantly, we create thought
pieces—from white papers to forecasts to research pieces—that project your company’s thought
leadership in your industry.

**What does standout content look like?**
1. [Fps Graphic Chart Logo]
   Presents relevant information in a graphic or table
2. [Graphic Search Results]
   Responds to searcher intent succinctly
3. [Graphic Answered Questions]
   Answers not just the stated question in the search, but questions the searcher didn’t know to ask

## Build Long-Term Brand Equity

Genuinely great content doesn't just grow revenue—it transforms your brand. Initially, your
prospects and customers start to see your company appear more in search results and generative AI
research. As your team begins to utilize that content in their email, social, marketing & sales
channels, a more widespread impression is made.

Over time, you'll notice a change across the board, from increased market share to more positive
customer perception.

GoldenPython is a curated directory of Python AI libraries, tools, platforms, and resources designed

Yes. Browsing tools on GoldenPython is completely free. Some external tools listed on our site may
have paid plans, but GoldenPython itself does not charge users.

GoldenPython is built for developers, data scientists, ML engineers, AI researchers, students, and

GoldenPython is updated continuously with new tools, frameworks, and Python AI resources. You can

# The Python AI Ecosystem

A curated reference of Python-native AI tools, platforms, and infrastructure.

## How to Use GoldenPython

##### 🔍 Browse Popular Tools

##### 🆕 Explore New AI Tech

###### Magenta (Music Generation)

][26]

###### PromptLayer

###### QuantConnect

Algorithmic trading platform using AI and quantitative finance.

][28]

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is GoldenPython?

GoldenPython is a curated directory of Python AI libraries, tools, platforms, and resources designed
to serve as a reference for discovering and comparing Python-native AI solutions.

### Is GoldenPython free to use?

Yes. Browsing tools on GoldenPython is completely free. Some external tools listed on our site may
have paid plans, but GoldenPython itself does not charge users.

### Can I contribute a new tool or suggest edits?

Yes. GoldenPython accepts tool suggestions and content improvements through a structured,
review-based submission process to ensure accuracy and consistency across the platform. Suggestions
can be submitted via our on-site forms, and our underlying content infrastructure is maintained
openly on [GitHub][29].

### Who is GoldenPython designed for?

GoldenPython is built for developers, data scientists, ML engineers, AI researchers, students, and
anyone working with Python-based AI technologies.

### How often is GoldenPython updated?

GoldenPython is updated continuously with new tools, frameworks, and Python AI resources. You can
subscribe to our newsletter to get notified whenever new tools are added.

##### Platform Updates

GoldenPython is continuously maintained and expanded. Subscribe to receive updates when new tools or
categories are added.

## Cut Through the AI Chaos!

Commodity LLMs are too slow, too expensive, and too unreliable to deliver the consistent outputs
real enterprise agents require. Loop.AI cuts through the hype with an AI Control Center that gives
you full sovereignty over your AI.

[With Loop AI Agent Orchestra, regain control and cut through the chaos of AI!]
[Wavy Abstract Background]

## [Your Enterprise AI Control Center][17]

#### ANY ML or LLM

Train custom Small Language Models on your proprietary data with [Loop Q][18], or leverage any
commercial or open-source LLM. Combine models within the same AI agent, benchmark performance vs.
cost in real-time, and hot-swap instantly as better options emerge.

#### ANY LEGACY SYSTEM

Your AI agents learn from human peers using historical data, seamlessly executing both simple and
complex tasks within your existing enterprise systems—whether through APIs or the same interfaces
used by your workforce.

#### ANY INFRASTRUCTURE

Run SLM training and low-latency inference on-premises or at the edge using NVIDIA GPUs. Deploy
across private clouds, hybrid environments, or any infrastructure—keeping your data within your
firewall while minimizing costs.

#### LOW-CODE TOOLS FOR TEAMS

No-code and low-code visual tools built for teams, featuring granular permissions for development,
testing, and deployment. Leverage a template library of AI agent blocks to quickly prototype, test,
deploy, and monitor key metrics for each AI Agent at scale.

##### Your data. Your models. Your agents. Your control.

## The AI Control Center in 2 minutes

## The Post-Commodity Advantage

### Others resell generic models. Since 2015 Loop delivers autonomous AI agents already performing
### real jobs inside Fortune 100 org-charts. Train custom SLMs on your data—no ML expertise
### required.

## Proven at Scale

### Over the past decade, Loop AI agents have processed millions of tasks for leading organizations
### in Automotive, Telecommunications, Banking, Insurance, Media, and Healthcare. Custom SLMs
### deliver the accuracy enterprises need on-premises, at a cost-effective price compared with major
### LLM providers.

## Popular Courses

[

### Artificial Intelligence (AI) for Managers

Artificial Intelligence (AI) is the simulation of human intelligence in machines that are programmed
to think and act like humans. It covers a variety of technologies, such as machine learning and deep
learning, and is used for various business and corporate applications to solve organizational
challenges and needs. This instructor-led, live training (online or onsite) is aimed at managers and
business leaders who wish to learn about the fundamentals of artificial intelligence and manage AI
projects for their organization. By the end of this training, participants will be able to
understand AI at a technical level and strategize using their organization’s data and resources to
successfully manage AI projects. Format of the Course Interactive lecture and discussion. Lots of
exercises and practice. Course Customization Options To request a customized training for this
course, please contact us to arrange.

][47]
[

### ChatGPT

ChatGPT is an artificial intelligence (AI) chatbot developed by OpenAI that follows instructions in
a prompt and provides detailed responses. This instructor-led, live training (online or onsite) is
aimed at developers who wish to learn beginner to intermediate-level skills in developing
applications using ChatGPT. By the end of this training, participants will be able to: Learn and
understand the fundamentals of ChatGPT. Use ChatGPT to build and develop web applications. Learn
ChatGPT best practices and real-world applications. Format of the Course Interactive lecture and
discussion. Lots of exercises and practice. Hands-on implementation in a live-lab environment.
Course Customization Options To request a customized training for this course, please contact us to
arrange.

][48]
[

### Kubernetes from Basic to Advanced

Docker serves as an open-source platform designed for constructing, distributing, and executing
applications within containers. Kubernetes takes this a step further by offering the essential tools
required to deploy and manage containerized applications at scale within a clustered environment. In
this instructor-led, live training (available on-site or remotely), participants will learn to
deploy a set of sample servers inside containers, followed by automating, scaling, and managing
these servers within a Kubernetes cluster. The course then progresses to advanced subjects, guiding
participants through the process of securing, networking, and monitoring a Kubernetes cluster. Upon
completing this training, participants will be capable of: Setting up and running a Docker
container. Deploying containerized databases and servers. Establishing a Docker and Kubernetes
cluster. Utilizing Kubernetes to deploy and manage various environments under a single cluster.
Securing, scaling, and monitoring a Kubernetes cluster. Course Format A combination of lectures,
discussions, exercises, and extensive hands-on practice. Notes Various Docker images may be utilized
as demonstrations during this training (e.g., Nginx, MongoDB, Tomcat, etc.). To request specific
images or any other customizations for this training, please contact us to make arrangements.

][49]
[

### Advanced Python - 4 Days

This instructor-led, live training (available online or at your location) is designed for developers
keen on mastering advanced Python programming techniques. Participants will learn to leverage this
versatile language to tackle challenges in domains such as distributed applications, data analysis
and visualization, user interface programming, and maintenance scripting.Course Format Interactive
lectures and discussions. Ample exercises and practical sessions. Hands-on implementation within a
live-lab environment. Customization Options Should you wish to add, remove, or tailor any section or
topic within this course, please reach out to us to make the necessary arrangements.

][50]

challenges and needs. This instructor-led, live training (online or onsite) is aimed at managers and
business leaders who wish to learn about the fundamentals of artificial intelligence and manage AI
projects for their organization. By the end of this training, participants will be able to
understand AI at a technical level and strategize using their organization’s data and resources to
successfully manage AI projects. Format of the Course Interactive lecture and discussion. Lots of
exercises and practice. Course Customization Options To request a customized training for this
course, please contact us to arrange.

### ChatGPT

ChatGPT is an artificial intelligence (AI) chatbot developed by OpenAI that follows instructions in
a prompt and provides detailed responses. This instructor-led, live training (online or onsite) is
aimed at developers who wish to learn beginner to intermediate-level skills in developing
applications using ChatGPT. By the end of this training, participants will be able to: Learn and
understand the fundamentals of ChatGPT. Use ChatGPT to build and develop web applications. Learn
ChatGPT best practices and real-world applications. Format of the Course Interactive lecture and
discussion. Lots of exercises and practice. Hands-on implementation in a live-lab environment.
Course Customization Options To request a customized training for this course, please contact us to
arrange.

[

### Kubernetes from Basic to Advanced

Docker serves as an open-source platform designed for constructing, distributing, and executing
applications within containers. Kubernetes takes this a step further by offering the essential tools
required to deploy and manage containerized applications at scale within a clustered environment. In
this instructor-led, live training (available on-site or remotely), participants will learn to
deploy a set of sample servers inside containers, followed by automating, scaling, and managing
these servers within a Kubernetes cluster. The course then progresses to advanced subjects, guiding
participants through the process of securing, networking, and monitoring a Kubernetes cluster. Upon
completing this training, participants will be capable of: Setting up and running a Docker
container. Deploying containerized databases and servers. Establishing a Docker and Kubernetes
cluster. Utilizing Kubernetes to deploy and manage various environments under a single cluster.
Securing, scaling, and monitoring a Kubernetes cluster. Course Format A combination of lectures,
discussions, exercises, and extensive hands-on practice. Notes Various Docker images may be utilized
as demonstrations during this training (e.g., Nginx, MongoDB, Tomcat, etc.). To request specific
images or any other customizations for this training, please contact us to make arrangements.

We enter into contracts with companies every day. Each of those contracts was with something with
legal personality – almost always a "legal entity". Yet too often we're ignorant of them and who is
behind them, with all the attendant risks that brings.

Whether you're in business, government, journalism, activism, research or a consumer — [our

## Do you really know who you’re dealing with?

We enter into contracts with companies every day. Each of those contracts was with something with
legal personality – almost always a "legal entity". Yet too often we're ignorant of them and who is
behind them, with all the attendant risks that brings.

Whether you're in business, government, journalism, activism, research or a consumer — [our
goal][39] is to help you better understand the companies you deal with.

Search the world’s largest open legal-entity database or plug the data direct into your applications
and processes.

## It shouldn't be hard to get legal-entity data you can trust

And yet it is. Legal-entity information is dispersed across hundreds of business registers that are
hard to navigate and impossible to access at scale. Traditional company-data aggregators are no
longer the answer either, given their opaque processes and provenance.

Verifiable accuracy is more important than ever, and you should expect more.

You need data built on deep expertise, rigorous data models and [well-founded, forward-looking
principles][43]. Data sourced direct from primary sources, curated with clear decision-making and no
hidden bias, and defined by open not proprietary identifiers and standards. Data you know you can
trust.

# Strategic intelligence and grounded context
# for marketing teamsstrategy teams
# and AI Agents.

Polaris7 maps the companies, technologies, and strategic movements shaping digital advertising,
marketing technology, and digital platforms. While raw AI search hallucinates names and misses
connections, our vertical knowledge graph provides the grounded entity resolution and context you
need to make decisions with confidence. Modern AI agents require precise, structured context to
perform research without hallucinating—which is exactly what our graph feeds them.

[Get Started for Free][4][How it works][5]

and relationships that matter inside complex digital ecosystems.

## Digital advertising, AdTech, MarTech, and digital platforms are too complex for current market
## intelligence tools.

The ecosystems behind digital platforms change constantly: vendors reposition, categories blur, and
critical signals are scattered across news, websites, and code. Traditional search and raw AI agents
cannot navigate this complexity without structure.

### Signal vs Noise

Raw AI search returns unstructured PR statements and SEO spam. Polaris7 structures actual strategic
shifts, partnerships, and product launches to isolate what matters.

### No Flat Databases

Generic databases only list records. Polaris7 maps parent-child structures, competitors, and
programmatic integrations to reveal the system architecture.

### Real-Time Updates

Static PDF reports are obsolete before they are printed. Our knowledge graph daily detects strategic
shifts as they unfold across the web.

### Grounded Graph

Standard LLM agents guess answers by querying raw, unsorted search results, leading to
hallucinations. Polaris7 agents operate on a validated knowledge graph, delivering facts you can
trust.

## Markets are systems, not lists.

Markets are not flat directories of companies. They are systems of roles, capabilities,
relationships, competition and strategic movement.

Polaris7 maps complex digital ecosystems—including digital advertising, marketing technology, and
digital platforms. By structuring these highly fragmented markets, Polaris7 helps teams understand
not just who the players are, but how they actually connect and compete.

The value is not in seeing more companies. The value is in understanding the right companies in the
right context.

Deliverable 01

#### Acquisition Target Lists

constraints. Polaris7 combines deep domain expertise in advertising, media, and digital platforms
with expert-grounded AI to provide strategic intelligence that actually understands industry
mechanics.

Standard LLM agents guess answers by querying raw Google results. They confuse parent holdings with

resolved, curated knowledge graph, delivering answers grounded in verified, real-world
relationships.

programmatically.

Automate commercial insurance qualification. The agent verifies eligibility, pulls carrier quotes,

Resolve complex support inquiries autonomously and scale to humans when necessary.

Qualify inbound leads before the first meeting. The agent gathers initial requirements, checks CRM
history, and arms your sales team with a complete briefing.

Restack uses the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to provide integrations to your agents. We also
provide the APIs and React components needed to build a custom frontend or manage your agents
programmatically.

[Docs][10]

## Enterprise use cases

Discover how IT and operational leaders use Restack to automate complex, pattern-based work across
their organizations.

### Healthcare & Pharma

Search approved medical claims in natural language. The agent automatically links references, tracks
usage, and flags expiring claims for compliance.

### Talent Matching Agents

Search massive candidate databases in natural language. The agent instantly screens for skills and
experience while keeping profiles automatically updated.

### Insurance Quoting Agents

Automate commercial insurance qualification. The agent verifies eligibility, pulls carrier quotes,
and smartly escalates to human brokers when needed.

### Support Agents

Resolve complex support inquiries autonomously and scale to humans when necessary.

### Sales Qualification Agents

Qualify inbound leads before the first meeting. The agent gathers initial requirements, checks CRM
history, and arms your sales team with a complete briefing.

Consultation

## Have a specific workflow in mind?

Let's discuss your use cases and see how Restack can put your repetitive work on autopilot.

[Book a consultation][11]

# Ship enterprise-grade AI agents without a dedicated AI engineering team

We provide the underlying infrastructure to build and orchestrate AI agents securely, so your team
can focus on automating processes

[Book a demo][8][Start building][9]
Integrations

## Seamlessly connect to your core systems.

Give your agents secure access to the tools your team relies on every day. Restack connects directly
to your CRM, ERP, and internal systems. We offer premium integrations for major enterprise tools,
including Salesforce, Microsoft Teams, ServiceNow, Zendesk or Veeva.

[Seamlessly connect to your core systems.]
[Define instructions in plain English]
Configure

## Define instructions in plain English

You don't need AI engineers to build powerful automations. Simply write your agent's instructions in
plain language. From there, you can test the outputs, refine the instructions, and use built-in
evaluation tools to continuously improve quality.

Enterprise-ready

## Enterprise security with complete visibility

Maintain total control over your data. Deploy Restack securely in your own cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure)
or on-premise. With real-time logs and complete audit trails.

[Enterprise security with complete visibility]
[Built on open protocols]
Open

## Built on open protocols

Restack uses the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to provide integrations to your agents. We also
provide the APIs and React components needed to build a custom frontend or manage your agents
programmatically.

[Docs][10]

## Enterprise use cases

Discover how IT and operational leaders use Restack to automate complex, pattern-based work across
their organizations.

### Healthcare & Pharma

Search approved medical claims in natural language. The agent automatically links references, tracks
usage, and flags expiring claims for compliance.

### Talent Matching Agents

Search massive candidate databases in natural language. The agent instantly screens for skills and
experience while keeping profiles automatically updated.

### Insurance Quoting Agents

Automate commercial insurance qualification. The agent verifies eligibility, pulls carrier quotes,
and smartly escalates to human brokers when needed.

### Support Agents

Resolve complex support inquiries autonomously and scale to humans when necessary.

### Sales Qualification Agents

Qualify inbound leads before the first meeting. The agent gathers initial requirements, checks CRM
history, and arms your sales team with a complete briefing.

Consultation

## Have a specific workflow in mind?

Let's discuss your use cases and see how Restack can put your repetitive work on autopilot.

# AI for Finance

**Genius solves financial services problems**

### Fund managers can't rely on today's AI

Today’s LLMs can’t be explained and aren’t reliable.

[ [Learn more] ][31]
[Diverging financial asset prices VERSES]
 

### Fund managers need an AI Genius

Genius™ helps fund managers to identify and quantify risks and quickly act on new data.

[ [Learn more] ][32]
[Financial services VERSES Genius attractors visualized]
 

### Inspired by the human brain

Active inference is superior to LLMs and learns on its own, with models that can always be
explained.

[ [Learn more] ][33]
[Increasing returns while managing risk - an illustrative example from VERSES]

> At Analog, we believe intelligence is about adapting, evolving, and seamlessly integrating into
> the fabric of everyday life. Genius didn’t just prove it could handle complexity—it showed us it
> could anticipate and creatively respond to real-world challenges. By embedding Genius Enterprise
> as a component of our solutions, we’re crafting the nervous system of tomorrow’s cities:
> intelligent, intuitive, and human-centric.

[Logo Analog icon]
Alex Kipman
Founder and CEO Analog

> Our Fortune 500 clients want AI that speaks their language, respects their rules, and delivers
> results they can trust. Off-the-shelf platforms rarely meet those standards. We believe that
> Genius lets us generate reliable, domain-specific predictions in weeks instead of months, and our
> team provides the know-how to take those models live. Becoming the first Certified Genius Reseller
> allows us to bring VERSES’ next-generation capability to enterprises worldwide.

[Logo Soothsayer icon]
Gaurav Agrawal
Founder and CEO Soothsayer

> We're excited to join VERSES in building trustworthy, explainable intelligence designed to enhance
> rather than replace human capabilities. Together, we will help organizations transition from
> unreliable, generic AI to domain-specific intelligence that adapts and grows alongside the
> businesses it serves. We feel that we are breaking significant new ground with our Enterprise
> program with VERSES while enabling our clients to be at the forefront of using cognitive AI as a
> catalyst for reinvention.

[Logo Kalosys]
Ken Rastin
Founder and CEO Kalosys

> Being able to explicitly model the cause-effect relationships of complex systems and quantify
> uncertainty means we can generate something not possible with traditional ML tools – results that
> are reliable, explainable, and assurance ready.

[Logo Prodigii]
Andy Tasker
Founder and Chief Strategist Prodigii

**Our technology: Inspired by the brain**

[Humans learn by prioritizing what is both important and uncertain][34] as our brains model the
world and continuously improve. For instance, when drivers see a ball roll into the road, they sense
possible danger (inference), and change their behavior (active) by slowing down and scanning the
area.

Like the brain, VERSES Genius™ has been designed to tackle problems with this process of [active
inference][35]. Genius interacts with the world and continually updates, allowing it to adapt to a
volatile, uncertain, complex, and ambiguous world.

Like humans, it can solve problems by sensing, planning, acting, and sharing.

**Our breakthroughs**

### Beating OpenAI and DeepSeek

In winter 2024/2025 we showed that Genius could learn quickly - and that it could beat competitors
playing Mastermind and Atari computer games. This proved that [Genius could achieve better results
at lower costs][36] that leading AI models such as Iris (a transformer model), OpenAI’s o1-preview
and DeepSeek R1.

### The world’s first digital brain beats Google DeepMind

In June 2025 we unveiled[ a modular digital brain][37], which [played classic computer games 60%
better and 97% more efficiently][38] than Google’s leading AI models. This performance is driven by
models that quickly adapt to new information without retraining.

 

### 2025/6 Finance

Over 2025/6 [we worked with a large global asset manager][39] (>$100bn AUM) to show how Genius can
help them achieve higher returns while managing risk in compliance with their governance policies.

> Our Fortune 500 clients want AI that speaks their language, respects their rules, and delivers
> results they can trust. Off-the-shelf platforms rarely meet those standards. We believe that
> Genius lets us generate reliable, domain-specific predictions in weeks instead of months, and our
> team provides the know-how to take those models live. Becoming the first Certified Genius Reseller
> allows us to bring VERSES’ next-generation capability to enterprises worldwide.

[Logo Soothsayer icon]
Gaurav Agrawal
Founder and CEO Soothsayer

> We're excited to join VERSES in building trustworthy, explainable intelligence designed to enhance
> rather than replace human capabilities. Together, we will help organizations transition from
> unreliable, generic AI to domain-specific intelligence that adapts and grows alongside the
> businesses it serves. We feel that we are breaking significant new ground with our Enterprise
> program with VERSES while enabling our clients to be at the forefront of using cognitive AI as a
> catalyst for reinvention.

[Logo Kalosys]
Ken Rastin
Founder and CEO Kalosys

> Being able to explicitly model the cause-effect relationships of complex systems and quantify
> uncertainty means we can generate something not possible with traditional ML tools – results that
> are reliable, explainable, and assurance ready.

[Logo Prodigii]
Andy Tasker
Founder and Chief Strategist Prodigii

**Our technology: Inspired by the brain**

[Humans learn by prioritizing what is both important and uncertain][34] as our brains model the
world and continuously improve. For instance, when drivers see a ball roll into the road, they sense
possible danger (inference), and change their behavior (active) by slowing down and scanning the
area.

Like the brain, VERSES Genius™ has been designed to tackle problems with this process of [active
inference][35]. Genius interacts with the world and continually updates, allowing it to adapt to a
volatile, uncertain, complex, and ambiguous world.

Like humans, it can solve problems by sensing, planning, acting, and sharing.

**Our breakthroughs**

### Beating OpenAI and DeepSeek

In winter 2024/2025 we showed that Genius could learn quickly - and that it could beat competitors
playing Mastermind and Atari computer games. This proved that [Genius could achieve better results
at lower costs][36] that leading AI models such as Iris (a transformer model), OpenAI’s o1-preview
and DeepSeek R1.

### The world’s first digital brain beats Google DeepMind

In June 2025 we unveiled[ a modular digital brain][37], which [played classic computer games 60%
better and 97% more efficiently][38] than Google’s leading AI models. This performance is driven by
models that quickly adapt to new information without retraining.

 

### 2025/6 Finance

Over 2025/6 [we worked with a large global asset manager][39] (>$100bn AUM) to show how Genius can
help them achieve higher returns while managing risk in compliance with their governance policies.

[VERSES uncertainty quantifcation for financial services]
[ARC AGI 3 gameplay example]

### Up next... ARC-AGI-3

VERSES is developing further modules for Genius which will allow us to solve complex problems, such
as those tested by the [ ARC-AGI-3 challenge][40]. ARC-AGI 3 is a test of human-like intelligence.
It does this by setting tasks that are deliberately designed to show the gap between cutting edge AI
systems and human intelligence. The underlying philosophy behind it is that intelligence is simply
“how quickly can you learn new skills?”

Powerful open source virtualization

For personal and enterprise use

VirtualBox is a general-purpose full virtualization software for x86_64 hardware (with version 7.1
additionally for macOS/Arm and with version 7.2 also for Windows/Arm), targeted at laptop, desktop,
server and embedded use.

Get Started

Download VirtualBox binaries and platform packages

[

Community

builds, and more.

[Community icon] ][10] [

Documentation

Learn from a variety of resources including user manuals, end-user and technical documentation, the
source code repository timeline, or the changelog.

[Documentation icon] ][11] [

Training

Access labs, tutorials, and videos to learn how to use VirtualBox. Quizzes are available to test
your learning.

[Training icon] ][12]
Join the VirtualBox community

Millions of users actively use VirtualBox

VirtualBox is a community effort backed by Oracle. Everyone is encouraged to contribute. Oracle
helps ensure the product meets professional quality criteria and offers support resources for users.
